description: classify's value is a tag set in a condition too: an alternative reads a word only where the classifier gives it KOhA, and the other only where it gives it no class (engine §10).
grammar:
%classifier lex  "mi" ∈ KOhA  "ui" ∈ UI


%rule text [{word}]
%rule word $k:W :: Known | $u:W :: Unknown %conditions KOhA ⊆ $k.value.classify(lex), $u.value.classify(lex) = ∅ %emits $
